batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c Parvez Rasool b KV Sharma

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b IK Pathan

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b Parvez Rasool

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b VR Aaron

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b VR Aaron

balls.text: length ball outside off, Rana slashes and misses. Starc takes off from the non-striker's end, Rana doesn't run. Ojha runs towards the stumps, disturbs them, and continues on to remove the bails at the non-striker's end as well.
Steyn pulls his length back, and Rana mishits this pull. It goes way up, and drops between long on and deep midwicket, both running forward to converge on the ball
Rana's done an AB! Walks across his crease, and scoops this full ball over short fine leg
looks for the wide yorker again, but it's a full toss that Starc slaps to deep point
wide yorker, gets it very close to the tram line as Starc reaches out and misses, the umpire has a look but he's unmoved
drifts onto the pads, Rana misses out, flicks it straight to short fine leg
low-full toss, and Bhuvneshwar does well to cut off this drive on his follow-through
full, on off, and Rana looks for the big drive but can only send it trickling to long-off
goes wide of the crease, angles the yorker towards the stumps, poked down to long-on
slower ball, but it's short, and Starc waits for it and cuts it behind point. Good placement.
full, on off, slapped to cover

big wicket, this. It's full and angled in, and did that keep a touch low? AB went back and across and went into a crouch to swat this towards midwicket, but the ball went under his bat and rammed into the stumps.
full and straight, Rana drives it powerfully between the stumps and the non-striker, no chance for long-off to cut that off
full, on off stump, Rana comes forward and drives to cover
full and wide, AB opens his bat face to steer it to point

he's gone! Kohli swings through the line again, doesn't quite hit it cleanly. It was there to be hit, but this one goes high and drops into Steyn's palms, cupped Australian-style, after he runs to his right from long-off.
another length ball, right in Kohli's slot, and he flicks his wrists to send it soaring over wide long-on
tries to slog this length ball out of the ground, gets no bat on it. Goes off Naman's gloves down to third man
dropped! slower ball, I think, doesn't come out right, it's a full toss, and AB slaps it over the off side, Dhawan dives forward and did well to get to it, but can't quite hold on
length ball, AB takes a big back-and-across step and hits it on-the-up over extra cover
angled in towards off, full, and Kohli hits it hard to long-on
that's very wide of off, and AB slaps it to cover, where Sammy misfields, ball goes rolling down to long-off
low full toss, and Kohli wrists it to long-on
Kohli gives himself room and slashes it over cover, Dhawan is the sweeper, cuts it off after a fumble, sends in a good flat throw, but the batsmen complete two easily
slower ball, almost in the blockhole, pushed down to long-on, took its time getting to the fielder, enough time for a comfortable two
full, on off stump, wristy drive to long-off
slower ball again, and again, no disguise, and Kohli sends that whistling back over his head
slides it full, down the leg side, and Naman takes it low, standing up
tucked off the pads to deep midwicket
slower ball, AB spotted that early, and he waits, keeps a stable base, and swings cleanly through the line to launch that over the long-off boundary
length ball, just outside off, chipped over cover
walks across the stumps, scoops it from outside off to deep backward square leg
width, AB slashes at it on one knee, gets a thick edge that races down to the third man boundary. Poor ball.
slower ball, opens the bat-face and takes a quick single to short third man to bring up his first half-century of the season
AB stays next to the line, slaps it to deep point
straighter this tinme, pushed down to long-off
full and wide. You don't bowl there to Kohli. Driven over extra cover.
full, outside off, flicked airily but safely down to long-on
length ball, on off stump, driven to long-on
back of a length, outside off, punched wide of Sammy at cover
length ball on the pads, flicked to deep backward square leg
full, almost in the blockhole, AB drives it to long-on
full, wide of off. Drives well, but Sammy does well to stop it, diving to his left from cover
tucked away to deep square leg
down the pitch, looks to drive it straight, goes off AB's pads to Rasool as the non-striker dives back into his crease
onto the pads once more, worked to deep midwicket
straighter, tucked off the pads wide of long-on
Change of angle doesn't help. Way down the leg side again
drifts down the leg side, Naman doesn't gather cleanly
finally! Yuvraj hits this pretty well, but he might have been too close to the pitch to get any real elevation, goes flat and low to Steyn at long-on. This one carried nicely.
driven down to long-off
length ball, bit of turn towards off stump, turns his wrists and bunts it into the leg side
down the pitch again, and he's in the perfect position for that lofted drive over extra cover. Made that look so simple.
shortish, pulled between long-on and deep midwicket. Long on picks it up running hard to his right.
down the pitch, not quite to the pitch, bottom hand comes off as he plays an out-of-control drive to cover
drops short now, and Kohli is quickly back to cut powerfully to point's right
down the pitch, Kohli swings those arms through the line, and it goes high, and way over the straight boundary
quickish, defended into the on side
down the pitch, big extension of the arms, and that's another lucky break for Yuvraj. Dale Steyn ran left from long-on, jumped and stretched his arms out, got a hand to it but can't catch it.
down the pitch, flicked to deep square leg
tucked towards square leg
sees Yuvraj come down the pitch, Rasool fires it down the leg side, too far wide for Naman to take. Oh. Hang on. There was some bat on that, as Yuvraj swept.
looks to sweep from outside off, inside-edge onto the back thigh.
overpitched, wide, and Kohli won't miss out. Drives that with a full swing of the bat, to the right of cover, to the left of long-off.
straightish length ball, Kohli stays leg side of it, drives it to cover
wide again, slightly fuller, square-drive to the off-side sweeper
short and wide again, tries to slash at it, misses, good take from Naman Ojha, standing up
short, wide, Yuvraj has to reach for it, and doesn't time it at all. Chopped to point
length ball, driven straight, too straight, hits the stumps at the bowler's end
what's happening here? Finch runs in this time from long-off, dives forward, and this chip from Yuvraj drops just short of him.
quickish ball on the stumps, worked to deep midwicket
length ball, swept to deep square leg
down the track, defends
swept to short fine leg
full, overpitched, driven hard down the ground. Steyn runs to his right from long-on, dives full-length, can't stop it, lands awkwardly on his bowling shoulder, but he looks okay
down the track, driven to long-off
driven to the right of Warner at deep cover
shortish, Kohli looks for the pull, but it's quick, and he jams it down towards the bowler
down the track, gets to the pitch, is in the perfect position to play the lofted drive over cover. Kohli can play that shot in his sleep.
slog-sweep, doesn't get hold of it, and once again, it drops just short of a fielder. Steyn was a little late running in from deep midwicket.  Hang on, he got his hands to it.
bit of turn, pitches middle, straightens towards middle and leg, defended
down the track, doesn't quite get to the pitch, ends up playing a half-hearted chip, which was a good thing for the batsman, because it dropped just short of Dhawan running in from long-on
bit of width, Yuvraj forces it straight to cover
tucked away from outside off to square leg
full, on leg stump, worked towards deep backward square leg
Yuvraj is down the track, gets too close to the pitch, flicks it to deep midwicket
full, on the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket
short, cut straight to point
down the pitch, Karn fires it full and wide, driven to cover
drifts onto the pads, tucked away in front of square leg
legbreak, turns from leg and middle down the leg side, seemed to go off his pad

got him! looks to heave it over the leg side, gets an edge that balloons into the hands of short third man. That seemed to go off the back of the bat. Will have to wait for a replay. Nope, it hit the toe of the bat.
quickish ball again, drops a touch short, Gayle flicks it towards deep midwicket
down the pitch again, doesn't get to the pitch, defends towards the leg side
quickish ball, sees Gayle give himself room, angled down the leg side, goes off Gayle's pads towards the off side
down the track, fires it in, hits him on the pad
takes a couple of steps down the track, tucks it towards midwicket with the turn
full ball, worked down to long-on for a walked single
back of a length, outside off, defended back to the bowler
shortish ball, Gayle pushes it square on the off side
drifts down the leg side this time, short, whipped off the hips backward of square.
length ball, angled across, Gayle opens his bat face and steers it behind point
opens his bat face, steers it behind point
length ball outside off, defended towards mid-on
typical Kohli nurdle, leans forward, wrists it from outside off towards mid-on
tucked off the hips to deep square leg
flicked from outside off to backward square leg
down the pitch, hits it over cover, doesn't quite get hold of it, bounces away past the boundary
starts outside leg, swings towards the stumps, Gayle plays it watchfully into the leg side
drifts onto Kohli's pads, worked away behind square
full, heading towards off, Gayle defends towards cover
bit of away movement again, from back of a length, and a bit of bounce. Gayle gets on his toes to chop it down into the off side.
tucked off the hips to the right of deep backward square leg
fuller, straighter, one of those top-of-off balls, defended watchfully into the off side. Gayle's front foot, as usual, is stationary.
pokes at this one from the crease, and he's beaten as it leaves him a touch.
full and wide outside off, Gayle lets it go.
teasing line, just outside off, bit of outswing. Kohli lets it go.
that was set up perfectly. This one comes back, pitching middle, hitting middle, and Parthiv's head is falling over as he plays all around it and is struck on the front pad, right in front.
another one leaves Parthiv, extravagant movement, and Parthiv lets it go.
similar delivery, but it's overpitched, and its line is a touch closer to the batsman, and Parthiv leans on it to send it scurrying past cover. Lovely drive.
leaves Parthiv this time, and he presses forward to shoulder arms.
leg-stumpish, bit of swing into Gayle, tucks it off his hips to deep backward square.

that's it! slower ball again, and Sammy gets it up and over cover, down towards the sweeper on the off side boundary. It goes bouncing down towards that fielder, giving the batsmen enough time to run the two runs they needed to win.
full ball, just outside off. This is good bowling, and Finch drives it to long-off
ball! slower ball, yorker just outside off, and Aaron is beaten as he tries to drive it down the ground
angled across Sammy and full, hit hard but all along the ground to wide long-off
slower ball, outside off, and Sammy clubs that down to long-off
full, just outside off, and Sammy has launched that over the bowler for six. What a shot to play first ball!
He's gone now! This was in the slot, full and outside off, but Naman has picked out the cover fielder
He's given Ojha room outside off, and he's used it brilliantly, leaning back and slicing under the ball to send it soaring over the deep point boundary
length ball outside off, and Finch doesn't time this swat across the line. Goes rolling down to deep midwicket
low full toss, angled into the stumps, and the batsman doesn't get hold of it. Goes down to long-off, on the bounce
Aaron isn't happy. Kohli isn't happy. It's a wide yorker, and it sends a cloud of white as it hits the tramline outside off, but it's given wide.

gives himself a lot of room, and Yuvraj follows him with a flat, shortish ball. Finch tennis-forehands it to long-on, who sends in a good flat throw that hits direct at the batsman's end but Finch, according to umpire Chaudhary, had completed his second comfortably
fuller this time, and it's slogged along the ground to deep midwicket
this is short and wide, and Naman cuts it past point, but the sweeper runs to his left to cut it off
flat again, on the stumps, and Finch makes room this time to slap it down to the sweeper
flat, fired in, and Aaron misses as he tries to pull. Ball just missed leg stump.
length ball, and Ojha stays leg-side of the ball and hits it over Yuvraj's head. Long-off runs around to cut it off
length ball, Finch makes room and slaps it over extra cover
slower ball, and it goes between the batsman and leg stump as he heaves and misses. Rolls down to Parthiv, and the batsmen set off for a bye. Parthiv misses with his underarm throw.
back of a length ball, angled in, and Finch is hit on the pads as he tries to work it into the leg side, on the hop
full, almost in the blockhole, and Ojha gives himself room to drive it down to long-off
low full-toss, and Finch pushes it back down the ground

uh oh. That's a full toss, and it's close to waist-high. Warner gives himself room, doesn't get hold of it, and it goes loopily and straight to cover. They check for height, and it's okay. Could RCB claw their way back here?
tries to cut again, hits it to point this time
slower this time, comes out of the hand better, Naman tries to late cut but hits it to Gayle at short third man
yikes. That's a rubbish ball from Yuvraj. Drags it down short, and way down the leg side.
short again, and Warner plays a checked pull to long-on
drags this short, but there's no room to do anything about it, and Naman chops it down to long-on

dropped! It was hit hard, and straight back towards Nechim, who put both his hands up in front of his chest, and took a painful glancing blow on one of his fingers for his effort. Bowling hand too. There's a bit of a delay with the injury, and they take the strategic time-out. We hope it isn't serious.
This is angled in, but angled in right into Warner's slot. He clears his front leg and swishes through the line to launch it over long off
slower ball, and Warner pushes his hands at it but checks himself at the last moment to chip it just wide of the bowler, to his right, for the single to long-off
full this time, and angled into the stumps. Ojha comes forward but stays next to the line to allow the checked drive to the off-side sweeper
slower ball, and it's a high, dipping full toss. Ojha tries to dab it down to third man, misses
full toss, and Warner slogs that to deep midwicket to get to his half-century
full, angled in towards off stump, driven to deep cover
full, angled down leg, and Warner clips it off his toes to deep midwicket
bit of air this time, and Naman clears his front leg to permit a free swing of his bat, and launches it over long-off
flat googly on the stumps, and Warner works it into the midwicket region
quickish, flat ball on off stump, and Naman opens his bat face to dab it to point
pushed through, defended into the leg side
tossed up again, and it's pushed down to the same fielder, who is now a wide long-on now that Warner is the batsman
tossed up, driven to wide long-off
back of a length, hurries towards Warner, who inside-edges onto his pads as he looks to tuck it into the leg side
goes back, opens his face, pushes the ball towards point
presses forward, defends into the off side

he's gone, is he? Yup. Warner dabs it straight to backward point, and both batsmen take off immediately. Quick throw from Yuvraj to Parthiv, and it's extremely close as he whips off the bails. Dhawan seemed to be juuuust a touch short of dragging his bat over the line, though, and the big screen flashes OUT.
fifty for Dhawan. Goes back in his crease and tucks it away towards midwicket
makes room to cut, hits it hard but straight to cover
pushed down to mid-off
tries the reverse-sweep, doesn't quite connect, goes trickling to point
tries to sweep again, misses, big lbw appeal, and it looked to be going towards the stumps, but he might have gotten some bat on it
over the same region again, but it's the slog-sweep this time. Warner clears his front leg and swings across the line
Chahal had been bowling well so far, but he drags this one down short. It's a long hop, and Warner pulls it away over midwicket
drops his length back, and Dhawan defends into the on side
down the wicket again, and gets inside the line to hit this inside-out over cover. Expert placement, and long-off has no chance running to his right
tries to push it into the off side, off the front foot, and run a quick single, but Warner sends him back
tucked off the legs towards midwicket
Warner runs down the track to this one, and swings cleanly through the line to launch it over long on
inside-edges onto the pads as he tries to pull

down the track, shortish delivery, tucked off the hips to deep square leg. Abu Nechim throws to the keeper's end again. Direct hit may have gotten Dhawan. It went to the keeper, on the bounce, giving him enough time to drag his bat in.
works this round from outside off just behind square on the leg side
keeps a bit low, Warner is trying to cut, ends up jamming it down into the leg side
quickish this time, Warner is hurried into this shot from down the pitch, is hit on the front pad as he tries to work his bat around it.
tossed up again. Warner is back in his crease, pushes it into the off side
tossed up, and Dhawan is down the pitch to drive it wristily to long-on
a little bit of width, but third man is in place to cut off Dhawan's late dab
shortish ball again, and Warner swivels to play a controlled pull that goes down to deep midwicket on the bounce
angled across again, a bit fuller, and Dhawan pokes it towards cover point
Dhawan jumps up and squirts this rising ball down into the ground
drops this short, and Dhawan is in a good position to half-pull, half-flick it behind square. Lovely timing
full and wide, and Dhawan throws his bat at it. Gets a thick edge down to a diving Aaron at third man. He seems to have hurt his knee as he stopped the ball. Looks okay though,
worked into the leg side. Deep midwicket runs in hard to keep it down to a single
Dhawan stays back to this one. It keeps a little low, but he still manages to squirt it into the off side with an open face
tossed up, dips on the batsman and turns in, inside edge onto the pads
this one skids on with the angle, and Warner pulls it to deep midwicket
bit of turn towards leg stump. It isn't that short, and Warner inside-edges that pull into his pads

tossed up onto leg stump, and Warner sweeps it towards deep square leg. Abu Nechim throws to the keeper's end, Warner dives in, and it's gone up to the third umpire. Comfortably in, beats the direct hit.
angled across Dhawan, who tries to glide it behind point with an open face. He's beaten, and so is Parthiv, who can't collect cleanly behind the stumps
leg-stump again, Warner looks to glance it past short fine-leg and misses out again. Misses the ball and it goes off his pad towards the leg side
leg-stump again, tucked carefully towards midwicket off the front foot
shortish, leg-stumpish, and Warner misses out, looks to beat short fine leg with a swivelling flick-pull, but finds the fielder
back of a length, on off stump, and Warner chops it towards backward point, where Yuvraj makes a good diving stop
full and wide, and Dhawan leans forward, gets low, and drives it past a diving cover. It's cut off at the boundary, though.
shortish, on leg stump, flicked off the hips towards midwicket
short ball, and Dhawan is into his pull too early. Ball hits him on the right thigh.
a little fuller this time, and Dhawan pushes it towards point off the front foot
back of a length, angled across Dhawan, who stays beside the line and punches it to point
straighter this time, and Warner knocks it down to long-off
length ball, which gives Warner a bit of room outside off. He throws his hands at it, and sends it whistling over mid-off
no turn on this one, and Warner is tucked up again. Clips it off his pads to deep square leg
tries to cut again, again no width, and he's found the point fielder
gives himself room, cuts it from a middle-stump line to cover
pushed down to mid-on
too close to cut, and Warner is beaten
and he's promptly greeted by Warner switching his hands and moving into a right-handed position to slap this powerfully behind square
poor bowling this. Mitch has been all over the place, and this is short and wide. Dhawan has all the time in the world to slash this over point.
this is full, on off stump, and Dhawan drives it to wide mid-off
slower ball outside off stump, Warner slashes and misses, and Parthiv fumbles behind the stumps as the ball rolls down towards him
slides down the leg side, trying, presumably, to bowl one into the blockhole
drifts onto the pads, and he works it behind square. Chahal runs to his left from deep square leg to cut it off, but can't stop them from running a second.
flicked off his pads towards deep midwicket
mistimed, but safe. Warner looks to hit this length ball over the top, doesn't get to the pitch, ends up scooping it high and back over the bowler. No one back, and it goes one bounce over the rope.
length ball, angling across towards off stump. Dhawan drives it to cover.
full, bit of swing towards Dhawan's pads, and the batsman ends up jamming his attempted drive into the ground
short again, not as short as the previous ball, and Dhawan pulls this for four, just behind square
Aaron bangs this in, and directs it well, it's rising towards Dhawan's shoulder, but he gets inside the line, watches it all the way, and hooks it over Gayle at fine leg
this is short and wide, and Dhawan misses out. Cuts it hard but straight to Yuvraj at point
Back of a length, angling into Dhawan. Slashes and misses.
full, on off, defended back to the bowler
tucked into the on side

Caught at first slip! Or would have been, had Gayle stood at an orthodox first slip rather than a wide third slip. Classical outswinger on a good length, Dhawan pokes at it, and edges it wide of the keeper
full, bit of shape away, but Dhawan watches it all the way, leans on it, and eases it to the right of cover
angles this into the pads, and hits Warner on the pads as he misses the flick
bit of shape away from Warner, who squirts it down off the back foot, defensively, towards the bowler
tucked off his pads into the leg side
leg-stumpish, and Dhawan works it off his pads to deep square leg
it's overpitched, and Dhawan drives, finds the gap through the covers
a touch shorter this time, and Dhawan defends off the back foot, into the on side
once again, Dhawan opens his face and pushes it to point.
slow, loopy, on off stump. Dhawan presses forward and pushes it to point.
